description: Neutral cleaning cases of SPEC 10.4, written by hand from SPEC 10.4, 9.1 and 8 (LenderLoanNumber) and SPEC_DECISIONS 13 and 45 (SPEC_DECISIONS 50). Every implementation of the cleaning rules runs every case. A field case puts `input` into one required cell of that field and evaluates the field rules in the order of decision 13: trim ASCII space, tab, CR and LF (WHITESPACE_TRIMMED); empty (MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD); a leading = + @ tab or CR, or any character of Unicode category Cc (UNSAFE_CHARACTERS); then the field's own rules, the first rejection ending the field. `original_amount` cases include its range 100.00 to 250,000.00; `current_balance` cases include ZERO_BALANCE. A `row` case gives a header and the cells of one record and evaluates the row rules first. `problems` lists every issue as field and problem; compare it as a multiset. `action` is ACCEPT with no issue, FIXED with FIXED issues only, REJECTED with at least one REJECTED issue. `canonical` is the cleaned value (amounts in integer cents; for a row an object of the canonical fields cleaned for that tape kind), or null when rejected. Digits are ASCII digits only.
